tools.name: crypto-tax_cost-basis-lots
tools.description: Match disposals to acquisition lots by FIFO, LIFO, HIFO or average cost and compute gains from a caller-supplied ledger and fiat values. tools.name: crypto-tax_specific-id-select
tools.description: Apply caller-chosen lot identifications to disposals, validate timing and quantities, and return matched basis or structured selection errors. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/specific-id-select Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, ledger, selections, fiatCurrency, fe

tools.name: crypto-tax_us-form-8949-rows
tools.description: Produce Form 8949 rows and Schedule D box totals from caller disposals using 2025 short/long-term and 1099-B / 1099-DA box rules. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/us-form-8949-rows Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, taxYear, disposals, roundToDollars, rows, totalsBy

tools.name: crypto-tax_uk-share-pooling
tools.description: Apply same-day, 30-day and section 104 share-pooling rules to a GBP ledger and return allowable cost, gains, pool balances and AEA. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/uk-share-pooling Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, ledger, taxYear, fiatCurrency, feePolicy, disposa

tools.name: crypto-tax_canada-acb
tools.description: Compute Canadian ACB and capital gains with superficial-loss detection for identical properties on a CAD ledger. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/canada-acb Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, ledger, treatment, fiatCurrency, feePolicy, disposals, acb, warnings, Cana

tools.name: crypto-tax_australia-cgt-discount
tools.description: Apply the Australian 12-month CGT discount by entity type after losses, from caller event proceeds and cost base. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/australia-cgt-discount Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, entity, resident, events, carriedForwardLosses, grossGains, l

tools.name: crypto-tax_germany-holding-period
tools.description: Classify crypto private sales under §23 EStG with FIFO (or caller method), one-year holding and the €1,000 Freigrenze. tools.name: crypto-tax_income-events-value
tools.description: Value staking, mining, airdrop and interest receipts in fiat using caller-supplied prices within a max lag window. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/income-events-value Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, events, prices, maxPriceLagHours, fiatCurrency, totalsByKind, m

tools.name: crypto-tax_transfer-match
tools.description: Pair outgoing and incoming transfers between the caller's own wallets by txHash or amount/time so they are not treated as disposals. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/transfer-match Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, ledger, windowMinutes, maxFeeRatio, pairs, unmatch

tools.name: crypto-tax_network-fee-allocate
tools.description: Assign network/gas fees to acquisition basis, disposal proceeds, expense or fee-asset disposal per caller policy. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/network-fee-allocate Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, fees, policy, adjustments, feeAssetDisposals, Allocate network

tools.name: crypto-tax_tax-loss-harvest
tools.description: List open lots with unrealised losses at caller prices and an estimated tax saving, with US/UK rule flags. tools.name: crypto-tax_derivatives-pnl
tools.description: Compute realised P/L for linear perpetuals/futures and options including fees and funding from caller trade inputs. tools.name: crypto-tax_unrealized-snapshot
tools.description: Replay a ledger to a date with a cost-basis method and report holdings, basis, unrealised gain, dust and unpriced assets at caller prices. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/crypto-tax/unrealized-snapshot Keywords: when computing crypto tax or cost basis, ledger, asOf, prices, method, feePolicy

tools.name: crypto-tax_exchange-csv-normalize
tools.description: Convert a caller CSV export into the shared ledger schema using a caller column mapping, or return a mapping template from headers. tools.description: Replay balances to find disposals without acquisition, negative balance, unmatched transfer-in and unpriced events before gains are computed.
